# Coinranking

Coinranking provides a comprehensive API for accessing cryptocurrency market data, including coin prices, market caps, and historical data.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/coinranking/.

## Actions

- **Get Coin History** (read-only): Retrieve historical price data for a specific coin over a time period.
- **Get Coins** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all coins with optional filters and pagination.
- **Get Global Crypto Market Stats** (read-only): Retrieve global cryptocurrency market statistics.
- **Get Reference Currencies** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all reference currencies with optional pagination.
- **Get Tags** (read-only): Fetch all coin tags.
- **Get Trending Coins** (read-only): Retrieve a list of trending coins ranked by user engagement and popularity.
